summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 financial results and a corporate update. The release discusses reduced operating expenses, cash position, and strategic positioning of wave energy for AI-driven infrastructure, including a mention of NVIDIA. No transaction, offer, restructuring, or special situation event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and business update filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
